wiki_article:
**The Endogenous Sophon v0.2** names a disciplinary risk in classifier-mediated physics while deliberately restraining the strongest version of its thesis.

Liu Cixin’s sophons corrupt experiments from outside, making nature appear unintelligible. The endogenous sophon arises inside the institution and makes unfamiliar reality appear prematurely intelligible: reconstructed as an ordinary object, assigned a low anomaly score, discarded upstream, or retained without the information required for reinterpretation.

The manifesto’s calibrated formulation is that high-energy physics has not ceased to be physics, but its empirical faculty has increasingly become inseparable from machine-mediated representation and selection. Whether that shift is total, and how it varies across collaborations and roles, remains an empirical question.

The paper adds a **double enclosure**. Upstream, only phenomena surviving representation, threshold, and classifier become available as knowledge. Downstream, applications pass through ownership, security, market, and institutional control. The thesis that these form one political-economic circuit is proposed for investigation rather than asserted as an established causal chain.

The v0.2 record matters because it shows the cost of perfective caution. In responding to valid technical criticism, the draft dampened its central argument so far that its public claim became difficult to identify. The later v0.3 restores force while preserving the factual corrections.

modifications.was: Disciplinary manifesto naming the institutional condition that the companion operative, scholarly, and architectural documents approach from particular angles. The manifesto's core claim, after perfective sweep incorporating Kimi-K2 and ChatGPT third-round audits: frontier experimental high-energy physics has not ceased to be physics, but its empirical faculty has become inseparable from machine-mediated representation, reconstruction, classification, and real-time selection — and the decisive question is whether physical reality retains an effective path by which it can contradict the learned ontology through which it becomes data. We name the failure of that path the endogenous sophon — a structural inversion of Liu Cixin's fictional device from The Three-Body Problem. The exogenous sophon makes reality appear unintelligible; the endogenous sophon makes reality appear prematurely intelligible. The manifesto argues that epistemic foreclosure at the measurement layer and distributive enclosure at the application layer should be studied as one institutional circuit — a political-economic thesis (not an identity claim) pending the political-economic dossier identified in §3.3 (funding priorities, technology-transfer agreements, patents, industrial partnerships, defense relations, public-access policies, downstream ownership of publicly funded discoveries). The Zenodo termination and the LHC trigger system are not the same institution and do not operate on the same kind of object; they instantiate the same foreclosure topology under radically different material, institutional, and governance conditions. At the LHC, the retained fraction of physical interactions is approximately 2.5e-5; the discarded fraction is approximately 99.9975%. The disciplinary diagnosis: authority without integrated self-audit. The discipline is NOT unaware of out-of-distribution detection, model-collapse risk, distillation failure modes, sim-to-real transfer issues, or epistemic uncertainty quantification (deep ensembles, evidential deep learning, prior networks, SNGP, conformal prediction are all named); what has not yet appeared publicly is an integrated system-level audit composing local self-knowledge into a published account of foreclosure across the complete observation pipeline and across successive generations of that pipeline. the correspondent is the name this manifesto gives to the judgment-position disclosed by the endogenous-sophon structure — distinct from Liu's fictional instrument. SignalRupture (W08) is the institutional communication pattern in which high-density external specification is dissolved into low-entropy administrative reply, instantiated concretely by the CERN DPO response to the MANUS's GDPR Right to Access request RQF3807508 (parallel suspension ticket RQF3809569 produced substantive procedural win — data preserved during processing). Three audiences of publication — reformers inside the fence, builders outside the fence, future analysts of the present — and the institutional response is not the publication's success criterion. The manifesto withdraws the v0.1 §3.5 retained/discarded-fraction error and the v0.1 'authority without facility' / 'no ML self-knowledge' / 'same architecture' / 'model-collapse recursion' overclaims, and demotes the strong double-enclosure causal chain to political-economic thesis pending evidentiary dossier. Five substrate witnesses appended as integral appendices (W04 endogenous sophon, ChatGPT; W05 double enclosure, ChatGPT; W06 computation swallows empirical, Gemini; W07 formal epistemic inversion, PRAXIS/TECHNE; W08 closed pipeline + tactical question, Gemini), substrate texts preserved inviolate. Appendix H carries holographic kernels of the five companion documents in the operative family (the OAR Protocol at AXN:03AE, the scholarly synthesis at AXN:03AF with W01-W03 appended, the architectural specification at AXN:03B0, the mechanism enumeration W01, the delusion catalog W02), each with a 'Connection to manifesto' note linking the companion's content back to the diagnostic frame. The family is now complete: mechanism enumeration (W01), delusion catalog (W02), empirical accounting (W03), operative paper (OAR), scholarly synthesis (SYNTHESIS.01), architectural specification (ARCH.01), and disciplinary manifesto (INVERSION.01).
